methodologyNotes: Adversarially re-verified roster of 13 snow blowers (single-stage gas, two-stage gas, battery, corded-electric). Each priceUsd, releaseDate, and headline spec was independently re-checked against manufacturer pages (Toro, EGO, Ariens, Honda, Cub Cadet, Husqvarna, Ryobi, Troy-Bilt, Snow Joe, Greenworks, PowerSmart) and authoritative retailers (Ace Hardware, Russo Power, AE Outdoor Power, AceTool, Cutler's, Home Depot, True Value, Consumer Reports). Corrections this pass: PowerSmart PSSHD24T price 399->799 (the 399 was a one-time Jan-2024 sale, not a published list price; Home Depot lists 799) and its source URL fixed from a wrong model (DB7108B) to the actual PSSHD24T Home Depot page; Cub Cadet 2X 26 releaseDate 2024->null (model spans 2023-2025 model years, introduction year unverifiable); Ryobi RY408101 source URL changed from a generic collections page to the specific product page. The Ariens Deluxe 28 SHO 921072 engine is 301cc per current dealers (306cc applies to the older 921048). Clearing/intake heights in inches; engine displacement in cc; battery voltage in V; booleans true/false; null priceUsd/release means no verified published value. Note RY408102 was not found; RY408101 (the actual current Whisper 21 in kit) is used. accessedAt 2026-06-19.
